title: Business English Conversation 5:  Making a Good Impression
content: 1. a drinker: a person who drinks a lot - She is kind of a drinker. - My boss is a big drinker. 2. So what?: a question that shows a person does not care or does not think that something is important A) I am the best salesman. B) So what? A) My hair is pretty. B) So what? 3. to tell a joke: to say something to make other people laugh - My co-workers like to tell jokes while working. - I don't know how to tell jokes well.
